ot_checklist_runs_halt_ck.name: ot_checklist_runs_halt_ck
ot_checklist_runs_halt_ck.value: ("ot_checklist_runs"."halted" = false and "ot_checklist_runs"."halt_reason" is null) or ("ot_checklist_runs"."halted" = true and "ot_checklist_runs"."halt_reason" is not null and "ot_checklist_runs"."completed_at" is null)

ot_definitions_published_ck.name: ot_definitions_published_ck
ot_definitions_published_ck.value: "ot_definitions"."status" = 'draft' or ("ot_definitions"."published_by" is not null and "ot_definitions"."published_at" is not null)

order_items_cancel_reason_ck.name: order_items_cancel_reason_ck
order_items_cancel_reason_ck.value: "order_items"."cancelled_from" is distinct from 'in_progress' or "order_items"."cancel_reason" is not null

lab_analytes_absurd_ck.name: lab_analytes_absurd_ck
lab_analytes_absurd_ck.value: "lab_analytes"."absurd_low" is null or "lab_analytes"."absurd_high" is null or "lab_analytes"."absurd_low" <= "lab_analytes"."absurd_high"

lab_analytes_applies_age_ck.name: lab_analytes_applies_age_ck
lab_analytes_applies_age_ck.value: "lab_analytes"."applies_min_age_days" is null or "lab_analytes"."applies_max_age_days" is null or "lab_analytes"."applies_min_age_days" < "lab_analytes"."applies_max_age_days"

lab_critical_calls_closed_ck.name: lab_critical_calls_closed_ck
lab_critical_calls_closed_ck.value: ("lab_critical_calls"."closed_at" is null) = ("lab_critical_calls"."readback_text" is null) and ("lab_critical_calls"."closed_at" is null) = ("lab_critical_calls"."closed_by" is null)

lab_items_invoice_pair_ck.name: lab_items_invoice_pair_ck
lab_items_invoice_pair_ck.value: "lab_items"."invoice_line_id" is null or "lab_items"."invoice_id" is not null

lab_reference_ranges_value_ck.name: lab_reference_ranges_value_ck
lab_reference_ranges_value_ck.value: "lab_reference_ranges"."low" is not null or "lab_reference_ranges"."high" is not null or "lab_reference_ranges"."text" is not null

lab_report_deliveries_collector_ck.name: lab_report_deliveries_collector_ck
lab_report_deliveries_collector_ck.value: "lab_report_deliveries"."channel" not in ('print', 'in_person') or "lab_report_deliveries"."collector_identity" is not null

lab_results_one_value_ck.name: lab_results_one_value_ck
lab_results_one_value_ck.value:
(case when "lab_results"."value_numeric" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "lab_results"."value_text" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "lab_results"."value_coded" is null then 0 else 1 end) = 1

imaging_contrast_administrations_vial_ex.name: imaging_contrast_administrations_vial_expiry_ck
imaging_contrast_administrations_vial_ex.value: "imaging_contrast_administrations"."vial_expiry" is null or "imaging_contrast_administrations"."vial_expiry" >= ("imaging_contrast_administrations"."given_at" at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date

imaging_contrast_reactions_severe_ck.name: imaging_contrast_reactions_severe_ck
imaging_contrast_reactions_severe_ck.value: "imaging_contrast_reactions"."severity" <> 'severe' or ("imaging_contrast_reactions"."treatment_given" is not null and "imaging_contrast_reactions"."managing_clinician_id" is not null)

imaging_definitions_published_ck.name: imaging_definitions_published_ck
imaging_definitions_published_ck.value: "imaging_definitions"."status" = 'draft' or ("imaging_definitions"."published_by" is not null and "imaging_definitions"."published_at" is not null)

imaging_reports_signed_shape_ck.name: imaging_reports_signed_shape_ck
imaging_reports_signed_shape_ck.value:
"imaging_reports"."status" in ('prelim', 'draft')
          or ("imaging_reports"."signer_id" is not null and "imaging_reports"."signed_at" is not null and "imaging_reports"."second_factor_at" is not null)

imaging_reports_amendment_ck.name: imaging_reports_amendment_ck
imaging_reports_amendment_ck.value: "imaging_reports"."supersedes_id" is null or "imaging_reports"."amendment_reason" is not null

imaging_studies_dose_ck.name: imaging_studies_dose_ck
imaging_studies_dose_ck.value:
"imaging_studies"."acquired_at" is null or "imaging_studies"."ionising" = false
          or "imaging_studies"."dose_ctdivol" is not null or "imaging_studies"."dose_dlp" is not null
          or "imaging_studies"."dose_dap" is not null or "imaging_studies"."fluoro_seconds" is not null

imaging_studies_contrast_ck.name: imaging_studies_contrast_ck
imaging_studies_contrast_ck.value: "imaging_studies"."contrast_given" = true or ("imaging_studies"."contrast_agent" is null and "imaging_studies"."contrast_volume_ml" is null)

imaging_studies_image_source_required_ck.name: imaging_studies_image_source_required_ck
imaging_studies_image_source_required_ck.value: "imaging_studies"."acquired_at" is null or "imaging_studies"."image_source" is not null

pcpndt_form_f_recorded_shape_ck.name: pcpndt_form_f_recorded_shape_ck
pcpndt_form_f_recorded_shape_ck.value: "pcpndt_form_f"."status" = 'open' or ("pcpndt_form_f"."signed_by" is not null and "pcpndt_form_f"."signed_at" is not null)

pharmacy_dispenses_claimed_has_order_ck.name: pharmacy_dispenses_claimed_has_order_ck
pharmacy_dispenses_claimed_has_order_ck.value: "pharmacy_dispenses"."status" not in ('verified', 'picked', 'billed', 'handed_over') or ("pharmacy_dispenses"."order_id" is not null and "pharmacy_dispenses"."dispense_no" is not null and "pharmacy_dispenses"."store_resource_id" is not null)

radiation_dose_register_dose_ck.name: radiation_dose_register_dose_ck
radiation_dose_register_dose_ck.value:
"radiation_dose_register"."dose_ctdivol" is not null or "radiation_dose_register"."dose_dlp" is not null
          or "radiation_dose_register"."dose_dap" is not null or "radiation_dose_register"."fluoro_seconds" is not null

radiation_dose_register_drl_ck.name: radiation_dose_register_drl_ck
radiation_dose_register_drl_ck.value:
("radiation_dose_register"."drl_quantity" is null and "radiation_dose_register"."drl_value" is null and "radiation_dose_register"."over_drl" is null)
          or ("radiation_dose_register"."drl_quantity" is not null and "radiation_dose_register"."drl_value" is not null and "radiation_dose_register"."over_drl" is not null)
